_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Los Angeles City College's degree heading pages, each by its State Code line: six local degrees that read 'Major Units: N' and 'Total Units: Minimum of 60' and fail unequal against the 60 (Business Administration 02718, Journalism 02728, English 02751, Physics 02755, Music 02736, Liberal Arts: Arts and Humanities 19843), two local degrees and four transfer degrees whose records began a page late and name no total (Cinema Production 02729, Creative Writing 43855; Psychology AA-T 32502, Spanish AA-T 38385, English AA-T 33147, Early Childhood Education AS-T 31030). Read before any step: what each heading prints for its units, its general education and its 60, and where its requirements begin. The page after each heading too. No model call.

questions.program_pages: Each program's heading, its Major Units and Total Units lines, any general education words, and the line its requirements begin under.
